FN-8VXSHFH-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 352
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Paul Lee
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/02/2024
House Bill 352 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Department of Youth
Services (DYS) by an estimated $3.2 million annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2025 and each
fiscal year thereafter, by requiring DYS to reimburse the counties for the cost of detention of
children in county custody beyond 12 business days after the juvenile court orders transfer of
custody to DYS.
Page 1

FN-8VXSHFH-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 352
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Paul Lee
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/03/2024
House Bill 352 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means General Fund would increase
the obligations of the Department of Youth Services (DYS) by an estimated $2.7 million in
Fiscal Year 2025 and an estimated $3.2 million in Fiscal Year 2026 and annually each fiscal
year thereafter, by requiring DYS to reimburse counties for the cost of detention of children in
county custody beyond 16 business days after the juvenile court orders transfer of custody to
DYS for Fiscal Year 2025, and beyond 12 business days thereafter.
Page 1

DYS to reimburse counties for the cost of detention of children in county custody beyond 16
business days after the juvenile court orders transfer of custody to DYS for Fiscal Year 2025,
and beyond 12 business days thereafter.
